title: Flávio Bolsonaro rumoured to have fled to Argentina after runoff loss
detail: The Guardian reports rumours that defeated candidate Flávio Bolsonaro left Brazil for Argentina after losing the Oct 25 runoff to Lula. The claim is unconfirmed; he had been ordered to surrender his passports on Oct 26.

title: Flávio Bolsonaro leaves Brazil for the United States after runoff defeat
detail: The New York Times reports that Flávio Bolsonaro has left Brazil for the United States following his runoff defeat to Lula, superseding earlier unconfirmed rumours that he had fled to Argentina.
